title: VIM Master: A Game That Teaches You to Edit Like a Power User
description:
🎮 Learn Vim, one level at a time.
VIM Master is an in-browser game that teaches editing motions & commands through interactive challenges.
✅ 16 levels
✅ Challenge & Cheat modes
✅ Achievements + shareable badges

⚡ Play. Learn. Master Vim.

👉 https://vim-master.com/
👉 https://github.com/renzorlive/vimmaster
